title: Airport Logistics, Flights & Hotel Reservations
group: A2.2 - Social Dynamics, Work & Everyday Life
objective: Mampu menavigasi alur perjalanan udara (check-in, boarding gate, luggage claim) dan reservasi akomodasi hotel

theory.summary: Dalam modul ini, kamu akan belajar cara berkomunikasi di bandara dan hotel menggunakan bahasa Inggris. Kamu akan mempelajari frasa penting untuk check-in penerbangan, melewati pemeriksaan paspor, mendengarkan pengumuman boarding, mengambil bagasi, serta memesan dan check-in ke hotel. Semua frasa ini sangat praktis dan akan membantumu merasa percaya diri saat bepergian ke luar negeri.
rules: Gunakan 'I'd like to...' atau 'I need to...' saat meminta layanan: 'I'd like to check in for my flight' atau 'I need to collect my luggage'
Untuk menanyakan informasi, gunakan 'Could you tell me...' atau 'Where is...': 'Could you tell me which gate?' atau 'Where is the baggage claim?'
Saat reservasi hotel, sebutkan detail spesifik: 'I have a reservation for a double room under the name...' atau 'Does the room include breakfast?'

commonTrap.explanation: Siswa sering lupa menggunakan artikel 'the' atau 'a/an' saat menyebut fasilitas bandara atau hotel, dan sering menggunakan 'I want' yang terdengar terlalu langsung dalam konteks formal.
commonTrap.wrong: Where is gate? I want check in now.
commonTrap.correct: Where is the gate? I'd like to check in now.

vocab.collocation: Please go to the check-in desk with your passport and booking reference.
You'll receive your boarding pass after checking in at the counter.
Your hand luggage must not exceed 7 kilograms.
Boarding will begin at gate 15 in thirty minutes.
After landing, proceed to baggage claim to collect your suitcase.
You must pass through passport control before entering the country.
I'd like to book a double room for two nights, please.
Here's your key card for room 305 on the third floor.
The checkout time is 11 a.m., but you can request a late checkout.
I have a reservation under the name Sarah Johnson for tonight.

dialogue.context: Sarah tiba di bandara untuk penerbangan internasionalnya. Dia pergi ke meja check-in untuk mendapatkan boarding pass dan kemudian mencari tahu gate keberangkatannya.

lines.speaker: Check-in Agent
lines.text: Good morning! May I see your passport and booking reference, please?
lines.translation: Selamat pagi! Boleh saya lihat paspor dan referensi booking Anda?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes, here they are. I'm flying to Singapore on flight BA205.
lines.translation: Ya, ini dia. Saya terbang ke Singapura dengan penerbangan BA205.

lines.speaker: Check-in Agent
lines.text: Perfect. Do you have any baggage to check in today?
lines.translation: Sempurna. Apakah Anda punya bagasi yang perlu di-check in hari ini?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes, just one suitcase. I also have this small bag as hand luggage.
lines.translation: Ya, hanya satu koper. Saya juga membawa tas kecil ini sebagai bagasi kabin.

lines.speaker: Check-in Agent
lines.text: That's fine. Here's your boarding pass. You're boarding at gate 22, and boarding starts at 10:30.
lines.translation: Baik. Ini boarding pass Anda. Anda boarding di gate 22, dan boarding dimulai pukul 10:30.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Thank you! Where do I go after passport control?
lines.translation: Terima kasih! Kemana saya pergi setelah pemeriksaan paspor?

lines.speaker: Check-in Agent
lines.text: Follow the signs to the departure gates. Gate 22 is in Terminal B. Have a pleasant flight!
lines.translation: Ikuti tanda menuju gerbang keberangkatan. Gate 22 ada di Terminal B. Selamat terbang!

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Thank you so much for your help!

speakingLab.context: Kamu baru saja tiba di hotel setelah penerbangan panjang. Mr. Khoirul berperan sebagai resepsionis hotel, dan kamu perlu melakukan check-in, menanyakan fasilitas hotel, dan mendapatkan key card kamarmu.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good evening! Welcome to Grand Plaza Hotel. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good evening! I have a reservation under the name Alex Thompson.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Let me check... Yes, I have your reservation here. A double room for three nights, correct?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, that's right. Does the room include breakfast?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Yes, breakfast is included from 6:30 to 10 a.m. in our restaurant on the ground floor. May I see your passport, please?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Of course, here it is. What time is checkout?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Checkout time is 12 noon, but if you need a late checkout, please let us know. Here's your key card for room 412 on the fourth floor. The elevator is just around the corner.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Perfect, thank you! Is there Wi-Fi available in the room?

quiz.question: At the airport, you need to get your boarding pass. You say: "Excuse me, I'd like to ___ for my flight to London."
quiz.explanation: Ungkapan yang benar adalah 'check in' yang berarti mendaftar atau registrasi untuk penerbangan. 'Check out' digunakan untuk meninggalkan hotel, dan 'check up' adalah pemeriksaan kesehatan.

quiz.question: The announcement says: "Passengers flying to Tokyo, please proceed to ___ 18 for boarding."
quiz.explanation: Di bandara, tempat boarding pesawat disebut 'gate' (gerbang keberangkatan). Kata 'boarding gate' adalah istilah standar di bandara internasional.

quiz.question: After your flight lands, you need to collect your suitcase at the ___ area.
quiz.explanation: 'Baggage claim' adalah istilah resmi dan paling umum digunakan di bandara untuk area pengambilan bagasi. Ini adalah terminologi standar internasional.

quiz.question: At hotel reception, you say: "Hello, I have a ___ for a double room under the name Martinez."
quiz.explanation: Untuk hotel, kata yang paling tepat adalah 'reservation' (reservasi). Meskipun 'booking' juga bisa digunakan, 'reservation' lebih formal dan umum dalam konteks hotel. 'Appointment' digunakan untuk janji temu dengan dokter atau profesional.

quiz.question: The receptionist gives you the ___ to open your hotel room door.
quiz.explanation: 'Key card' adalah istilah yang tepat untuk kartu elektronik yang digunakan untuk membuka pintu kamar hotel modern. Urutan kata yang benar adalah 'key card', bukan 'card key'.
